summary: Daikatana entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Daikatana
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with exact patch/community-fix state documented

emulation.notes: Use Project64 or SameBoy only for port comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release with documented patch/fix/renderer state

primary.version: Current PC release with 1.3/community patch state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the core route for Daikatana and remains the best way to document patches, fixes, controls, and multiplayer/bot/community state. Nintendo 64 and Game Boy Color versions are materially different ports and should not replace the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam or GOG, with official/community patch state recorded. Document build, 1.3/community patch use, renderer, widescreen/FOV, controls, companion AI state, difficulty, and whether N64/GBC ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the original and best-preserved route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC FPS route with patch/fix options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Community fixes improve playability but must be labeled separately from original-release behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record 1.3/community patch use; do not conflate console/handheld ports with the PC route.
